layout.footer: Pukalani · Community software made and hosted in Germany

communities.title: Your communities
communities.heading: Your communities
communities.intro: Pick a community to open its dashboard.
communities.emptyText: Once you create a community or get invited to one, it shows up here.
communities.trialEnding: 1 day left in your trial | {n} days left in your trial
communities.trialEnded: Trial ended — running on the Basic plan

gate.title: Set up your community
gate.heading: Welcome, {name}.
gate.intro: Pukalani is in early access — you need an invite code. After that we'll set up your community together in a few steps.
gate.codeHint: It's in your invitation email. Capitalisation doesn't matter.
gate.rejected: That code isn't valid (any more). Check the spelling — or ask us for a new one.
gate.noCode: No code? Tell us what you want to use Pukalani for — we invite new communities continuously.

request.title: Request early access
request.intro: Pukalani is still in early access. Leave your address — we'll get back to you with an invite code as soon as a spot opens up.
request.emailHint: The code goes to this address and is only valid for it.
request.noteLabel: What do you want to use Pukalani for?
request.noteHint: Two sentences are enough. Helps us judge whether it's a fit right now.
request.failed: That didn't work just now. Try again in a minute.
request.privacy: We store your address only to send you access — and delete it if nothing comes of it.
request.doneBody: We have your request. As soon as a spot opens up, you'll get an invite code by email.
request.doneHint: Check your spam folder too — and if the email doesn't arrive, just write to us again.

basics.title: Name and address
basics.heading: Let's start, {name}.
basics.intro: A working title is perfectly fine — you can change both later.

size.title: How many people are you bringing?
size.intro: An estimate is enough. We use it to set things up for you, not to hold you back.

category.title: What is yours about?
category.intro: Pick the closest one. It doesn't decide what you get — it helps us show you relevant things.

description.title: Who are you bringing together?
description.intro: Two sentences are enough. They become the first version of your home page — editable once you're in.

goal.title: What would feel like real success in six months?
goal.intro: Pick what matters most. We use it to show you the right next steps.

vibe.title: Which mood fits?
vibe.intro: Colours and type for your community. Six starting points from our catalogue.
vibe.changeable: Later you get the full range — 26 colour worlds with eleven shades each, plus your own fonts.

summary.title: Does this look right?
summary.intro: Check your answers. One click creates your community — the trial starts at that moment.

fields.name: What should your community be called?
fields.nameHint: The name appears in the site header and in emails.
fields.addressHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. You can connect your own domain later.
fields.addressTaken: That address is already taken. Please pick another one.
fields.addressUnknown: We couldn't check just now — you can still continue.
fields.descriptionHint: Who do you bring together, and what for? Write it the way you'd tell a friend.
fields.suggestFailed: The draft didn't work. Feel free to write your own — or try again later.
fields.suggestNote: The draft comes from an AI and is just that: read it, change it, throw it away. Nothing is saved until you continue.

other.label: Something else
other.hint: Tell us in the next step.

relationships.label: Build relationships
relationships.hint: Members who show up for each other.

knowledge.label: Collect knowledge
knowledge.hint: Findable instead of lost in chat.

reach.label: Reach more of the right people
reach.hint: Publicly readable content that gets found.

summary.name: Name
summary.trialTitle: 14 days of Pro, no payment details
summary.trialBody: After that your community continues on the free plan — with smaller limits. Nothing is locked, nothing is deleted.

errors.hostTaken: That address was just taken. Go back one step and pick another one.
errors.notAllowed: That didn't work: either the invite code is no longer valid, or you already have a community in its trial.
errors.invalid: One of the answers doesn't fit. Please walk back through the steps.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't create the community just now. Try again in a minute — your answers are kept.

done.title: Your community is live
done.heading: {name} is live.
done.intro: You're the owner. The community is publicly readable — anyone can see and find your content.

hints.private: Public by default: your content is readable by anyone and found by search engines. "Members only" is a switch in the settings — it also takes everything published so far out of public view.
hints.trial: The trial runs for 14 days. After that the free plan applies automatically — smaller limits, nothing for you to do.
hints.settings: Name, address, colours and home page can be changed any time in your community's dashboard.

validation.slugInvalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
validation.slugReserved: That address is reserved. Please pick another one.

trial.endingTitle: 1 day left in your trial | {n} days left in your trial
trial.endingText: After that your community continues on the free Basic plan — nothing is locked, nothing is deleted. A subscription keeps the Pro features.
trial.endedText: Your community now runs on the free Basic plan. All content and members are still there; the Pro features need a subscription.

subscription.title: Subscription & billing
subscription.help: Which plan applies to your community, what it costs, and where to find invoices and payment details.
subscription.noTenantText: This page belongs to a community. On a dedicated instance the operator handles billing, not an individual community.
subscription.priceNote: The binding amount is the one shown in the Stripe checkout — that is also where tax is calculated from your billing address.
subscription.chooseHelp: After you buy we hand you over to Stripe. You come back to this page; the new plan appears once the payment is confirmed.
subscription.downgradeHint: Basic applies automatically whenever no paid subscription is running. Downgrading and cancelling go through "Invoices & payment method".
subscription.portalHint: The Stripe portal holds every invoice and lets you change the payment method, switch plans or cancel.
subscription.portalNote: You briefly leave Pukalani and land at Stripe.
subscription.noSubscription: No subscription yet — so there is nothing to bill.
subscription.alreadySubscribed: A subscription already exists. Changes go through "Invoices & payment method".
subscription.checkoutSuccess: Thank you! The payment is being processed — your plan will update shortly.
subscription.errorGeneric: That didn't work just now. Please try again in a minute.
subscription.checkoutErrorHint: The checkout never opened — nothing was charged and your plan stays as it is.
subscription.portalErrorHint: The billing portal could not be opened. Your subscription is unaffected.

basic.name: Basic
bullets: One community with its own address and its own look
Your own pages such as imprint, about or house rules

branding.noTenantText: This page sets the colour world of ONE community. On this instance the look belongs to the operator — it is set under "Themes".

members.title: Members
members.description: Everyone who belongs to your community. People become members by joining (when registration is open) or by invitation. "Revoke access" really does take that membership away — they no longer see members-only content and can only come back through a new invitation.
members.name: Name
members.emptyText: Invite your first members — they get an email with a link and are in with one click. With open registration, members also arrive on their own as soon as they sign up or write their first post.

roleHelp.admin: Manages everything: content, moderation, appearance, members.
roleHelp.moderator: Moderates reports and posts — does not write content.
roleHelp.editor: Maintains posts, pages, events and media — does not moderate.
roleHelp.viewer: Reads along and writes comments. No access to management.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: Enter an email address, pick a role — done.
invite.emailHelp: If the person already has a Pukalani account, one click after signing in is enough. Otherwise they create one via the link.
invite.sentExisting: {email} has an account — invitation sent, one click is enough.
invite.sentHint: The link is valid for 7 days. Until then the invitation sits below under “Open invitations” and can be revoked.
invite.failed: The invitation could not be sent.

invites.title: Open invitations
invites.description: Sent, but not accepted yet. Revoking makes the link invalid immediately.

revoke.title: Revoke invitation?
revoke.text: The link sent to {email} will stop working. You can invite again at any time.

remove.title: Revoke access for {name}?
remove.text: They no longer belong to this community: no more members-only content, and they stop showing up among the people present. They can only come back through a new invitation — not even when registration is open. Their posts, comments and course progress REMAIN and keep their name; from now on it shows "Former member" next to it. Deleting an account is a different matter.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership to {name}?
transfer.text: This person becomes the owner of the community. You stay on as administrator — you keep management, but hand over transfer and billing.

errors.self_demote: You cannot take rights away from yourself. Ask another administrator to do it.
errors.self_remove: You cannot revoke your own access.
errors.last_owner: There always has to be an owner. Transfer ownership first.
errors.already_member: That address already belongs to this community. Change their role right in the list.
errors.not_a_member: This person is not (or no longer) part of this community.
errors.unchanged: This person already has that role.
errors.failed: That didn't work just now. Please try again.
errors.failedHint: Nothing in the member list changed. Reload the page and try again.

join.title: Accept invitation
join.invalid: This invitation is no longer valid. Please ask for a new one.
join.wrongAccount: This invitation was issued for a different email address. Sign in with the invited address.
join.noneText: There is no invitation here for this account. Check the link from your email — or ask the community team for a new one.
